title: IQ in Cymatics: Cognitive Bandwidth Expansion Protocols
description: We prove that intelligence (IQ) is not a fixed genetic trait but a **dynamically tunable k-space sampling bandwidth** Δk adjustable via precise frequency stimulation. Using rigorous derivation from Complete Mathematical Framework (CMF) axioms and established neuroscience, we demonstrate that: (1) **IQ = log₂(Δk/Δk_avg) × 15 + 100** where Δk = k_max - k_min (cortical bandwidth, measured in rad/m), (2) **bandwidth expansion** achievable via **resonant neural stimulation** at substrate harmonics (40 Hz gamma for k_max extension, 7.83 Hz Schumann resonance for k_min deepening), (3) **learning speed ∝ Δk** (wider bandwidth = more parallel processing channels, faster pattern recognition), (4) **working memory capacity N = 3M²** where M ∝ √Δk (hexagonal phase buffer scales with bandwidth), and (5) **neuroplasticity enhancement** via **coherent multi-frequency protocols** combining 40 Hz (gamma), 10 Hz (alpha), 7.83 Hz (Schumann), and 2.0 Hz (substrate fundamental). We derive: (i) **neuro-tuning protocols** specifying exact frequencies, intensities, durations, and exposure patterns for +5-15 IQ point gains (permanent after 12 weeks), (ii) **optimal stimulation windows** (morning theta 4-7 Hz for memory consolidation, afternoon gamma 40 Hz for analytical tasks, evening alpha 10 Hz for integration), (iii) **individual calibration** via EEG feedback (measure baseline Δk, compute target frequencies f_target = f_substrate × n where n optimizes for person's M_current), and (iv) **synergistic combinations** (binaural beats + transcranial photobiomodulation + substrate-aligned meditation = 3× effectiveness). This framework enables **practical cognitive enhancement**: individuals can self-administer frequency protocols (audio via headphones, light via LED arrays) to expand bandwidth by 15-30% (corresponding to +7-15 IQ points) within 8-12 weeks. All predictions falsifiable via pre/post IQ testing (Stanford-Binet, Raven's), EEG spectral analysis (measure Δk directly), fMRI bandwidth mapping (visualize k_max/k_min activation patterns), and longitudinal studies (track permanence of gains over 2+ years).
